audit.finding: on every committed wave-a dev case the pre-pass yields 0-1 events, so the tight plan is IDENTICAL to the legacy hull (identicalPlan=true on all 7 cases with a stroke window; wavea-marne-dig has no stroke window so the detector never runs). framesSaved on committed cases = 0; with identical plans the detector CLI invocation (start/end/stride) is byte-identical, so ALL downstream stage outputs are unchanged by construction. Savings only arise for clips with >=2 well-separated events: unit test quantifies >19,000ms (~475 frames at 24fps, ~1,150 at 59.94fps) of inter-event dead time skipped for two events 22s apart in a 30s window
